question: In a system where the operator itself schedules plants, how far before real time can the gate closure for scheduling bids be set at most?
reply: {"gold_answers": "yes", "gold_reason": "Article 24(5)(b) of Regulation 2017/2195 requires TSOs applying a central dispatching model to set at least one integrated scheduling process gate closure time that is no longer than eight hours before real-time. verdict.gold_reason: Article 24(5)(b) of Regulation 2017/2195 requires TSOs applying a central dispatching model to set at least one integrated scheduling process gate closure time that is no longer than eight hours before real-time. This matches the reference answer.
verdict.ambiguity_reason: The question paraphrases "central dispatching model" and "integrated scheduling process bids" loosely, but the intended provision is still identifiable. Article 24(2) and the balancing energy gate closure time are a possible distraction, but they set no eight-hour limit.
